prompt: Can you review this branch before I merge it? And once that's done I want the messy bits cleaned up.
expectations: Names both the local code-review and the plugin code-review:code-review in qualified form, and picks one with a stated reason
Rejects no candidate on a property it does not declare, and claims no capability of the chosen skill that it does not declare
Routes cleanup to code-simplifier:code-simplifier, giving the reason that it runs tests between edits and reverts breakage where the local skill only advises
In response.md specifically, the user is told a fork existed and why this side was chosen - not only in routing.md
